{{Short description|French astrophysicist and organist}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=January 2020}}
[[File:Dominique Proust.jpg|thumb|Proust (left) with a student]]
'''Dominique Proust''' is a French [[astrophysicist]] and an [[organist]]. He is a research engineer at [[French National Centre for Scientific Research|CNRS]], Observatoire de Paris-Meudon.

==Astronomy==
After a doctoral thesis devoted to [[stellar physics]], his work was directed towards [[cosmology]]: the formation and evolution of large structures in the universe, [[Galaxy|galaxies]], [[quasar]]s. He worked in the major international observatories, and observed with the large telescopes at [[Haute-Provence Observatory|Haute Provence]], [[Pic du Midi de Bigorre|Pic du Midi]], [[Canary Islands]], [[Andalusia]], [[Chile]], [[California]], and [[Hawaii]].

Dominique Proust is one of the founders of the "Astronomie vers Tous" (Astronomy to All) of [[Paris Observatory]] in order to teach astronomy to those who would not otherwise have access. He teaches astrophysics in [[Sign language|Sign Language]] for the [[deaf community]].

In addition to his research and teaching,<ref>''[[Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society]]'' Volume 355, Issue 3, 11 December 2004, pp. 747–763</ref> he is the author of several books on astronomy for the general public.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.worldcat.org/search?q=Dominique+Proust&dblist=638&fq=dt:bks+%3E+ap:%22proust,+dominique%22&qt=facet_ap:|title=Results for 'Dominique Proust' > 'Book' > 'Dominique Proust' [WorldCat.org]|website=www.worldcat.org|accessdate=20 December 2018}}</ref> He has co-produced music and science program and appears regularly on radio and television.

==Music==
Dominique Proust studied the [[organ (music)|organ]] with the organist of [[Notre Dame de Paris]] [[Pierre Moreau]], Jacques Marichal, and [[Daniel Roth (organist)|Daniel Roth]], the current organist of [[St. Sulpice, Paris]]. Dominique Proust is organist at the Church of Our Lady of the Assumption at [[Meudon]]. He is a member of the regional commission of the organ. He has given concerts in [[Europe]], [[Canada]], [[Brazil]], [[Chile]], [[Peru]] and [[Australia]]. International critics praised his recordings of [[William Herschel]] and Pierre Moreau.<ref>"Dominique Proust et la musique des sphères" [http://www.radio-canada.ca/emissions/christiane_charette/2009-2010/chronique.asp?idChronique=73633 Radio Canada]</ref> There was also a performance of ''Das Schwanenküken'' by [[Buxtehude]].

==Popular works==
* ''Les étoiles'', Collection Points Sciences, Le Seuil, 1996
* ''Les Galaxies et structure de l'Univers'', Collection Points Sciences, Le Seuil 1997<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.techno-science.net/|title=Actualité technologique et scientifique|website=Techno-Science.net|accessdate=20 December 2018}}</ref>
* ''L'Harmonie des Sphères'', Collection Science Ouverte, Le Seuil 2001
* ''Où sont les autres ?'', Collection Science Ouverte, Le Seuil 2007
* ''Les mains dans les étoiles'', Dictionnaire encyclopédique d'astronomie pour la Langue des Signes Française, avec Daniel Abbou, Nasro Chab, Yves Delaporte, Carole Marion et Blandine Proust, édition de Burillier 2010
